import statistics
import math

# Total reserve assets for CY1983-1990 (in millions of dollars)
# From IFS-1 table:
# 1983: 33,747
# 1984: 34,934
# 1985: 43,186
# 1986: 48,511
# 1987: 45,798
# 1988: 47,802
# 1989: 74,809
# 1990: 83,318

values = [33747, 34934, 43186, 48511, 45798, 47802, 74809, 83318]

# Population standard deviation (sigma) - for complete dataset
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

# Sample standard deviation (s) - using n-1 denominator
sample_variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)

print(f"Values (in millions): {values}")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")
print(f"Population variance = {variance}")
print(f"Population standard deviation = {pop_std}")
print(f"Sample standard deviation = {sample_std}")
print(f"\nPopulation std rounded to 4 decimal places: {pop_std:.4f}")
EOF
